heading: Today
text: Partly sunny in southern valleys.  Clouds from the Adirondacks and Rt. 4 north, breaking for some sun, mostly south of Rt. 2.  An isolated rain or snow shower in the mountains.  Highs from the low 40s to low 50s north to south.  Winds west to northwest near 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph east of the Green Mountains, diminishing in the afternoon.

heading: Tonight
text: Some breaks in the clouds in the evening, then mostly cloudy.  A chance of snow or rain in NY into southwest VT late.  Lows in the upper 20s to low 30s east, in the 30s west.  Winds light and variable.

heading: Thursday
text: Becoming cloudy.  Periods of snow and rain developing southwest to northeast, more likely in the afternoon.  Accumulations a trace to 2 inches, mostly over higher elevations. Highs in the upper 30s to low 40s.  Light winds becoming north less than 10 mph.
